fields.description: Set during installation. Use Test Connection to verify.
fields.label: Agent URL

fields.description: Seconds before giving up on a reply. Default 120.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: What happens when the assistant wants to create, change or delete a record. "Ask every time" shows an Allow / Deny card in the chat. Deletes keep asking unless all changes are auto-approved.
fields.label: Write Approval
fields.options:
Ask every time
Auto-approve creates and updates
Auto-approve all changes
Read only

fields.description: Users may choose "Auto-approve creates and updates" for themselves in the sidebar, and "Allow all in this conversation" on a card. Deletes, scripts, users, roles and permissions always ask.
fields.label: Let Users Turn On Auto-Approval

fields.description: Changes from MCP clients other than this sidebar, such as Claude Desktop or Claude Code, signed in with an API key or OAuth as a user. They change only what that user may change; users, roles, scripts, permissions and the assistant's own settings stay in Desk. Each change is recorded in AI External Write Log.
fields.label: Writes from Other MCP Clients
fields.options:
Read only
Allow creates and updates
Allow all changes

fields.description: Chat panel width in pixels. Range 300–600.
fields.label: Sidebar Width

fields.description: Press to toggle the chat from anywhere on the desk.
fields.label: Keyboard Shortcut
MCP Server URL
fields.description: This site's frappe-mcp-server, if one is running for it. Vyogo Forge AI reads live data through it.
Comma-separated addresses or prefixes the agent may call from. Empty allows any.
fields.label: Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: One role per line, e.g. Sales User, to let the agent read business documents.
fields.label: Additional Read Roles

fields.description: Whether Vyogo Forge AI's changes wait for a System Manager. With "Apply what the skills cover" (the default), a change applies itself when every record is a type listed below and none of it runs code (scripts, web forms, notifications always wait). It is applied as the approver below, logged in the Change Log, and can be rolled back.
fields.label: Forge Autonomy
fields.options:
Approve each change
Apply what the skills cover

fields.description: A System Manager who answers for changes that apply themselves; they are made with this user's permissions. Blank means Administrator.
fields.label: Approve As

fields.description: One DocType per line: the record types the assistant's writes skills govern. Types that run code and Desk-only types are refused.

fields.description: How the assistant presents itself in the sidebar. A host that manages this site can set these in site_config (frappe_ai_assistant_name, _byline, _logo_url, _accent); those win over the values here.

fields.label: Byline
fields.description: A short line shown after the name, e.g. who provides the assistant. Leave empty for none.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: A small square mark shown before the name.

fields.label: Accent Colour
fields.description: Fills the send button and your own messages. Text on it switches between dark and white for contrast. Empty keeps the neutral default.
